player_prompt.intro:
Nze mwadi {player_id} ku SimpleTak.
Ku bwato, mifupa yeno ikwata na '{player_stone}' na mifupa ya mwadi wane ikwata na '{opponent_stone}'.

Ku miketo yeno, chanya seli moke (na numelo ya yeno) na kwata mifupa yeno kuno.
Kadi, kano '[12]' kwata mifupa yeno mu seli 12.

Mweno mwadi ni kukwata milangi ya mifupa yeno ikwata ku milangi ikwata ya bwato (dju-djuo na tshitshi-tshitshi).

invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Numero wa kasolonyi ka mu mukanda {cell_num}. Udi ne bua kuikala pankatshi pa 0 ne {max_board_num}.
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Cell {cell_num} is already occupied. Choose an empty cell.

action.placement: Mwadi {current_player_id} akelaki simbu ya yeno ({symbol}) mu seli {cell_num}.

outcome.draw: The board is full. It's a draw!
